summary_1line: Damayanti suspects the charioteer Vahuka is the disguised Nala and sends Kesini to question and observe him, eliciting an emotional response revealing his grief.

image_candidates.scene_text: Damayanti stands on a palace terrace watching anxiously as her messenger Kesini approaches the misshapen charioteer Vahuka beside the royal chariot.
Vahuka, sitting beside the chariot in the stables, speaks with choked voice and tears filling his eyes while hiding his true identity.
Kesini returns to Damayanti and reports the weeping charioteer while the princess listens with tense hope and grief.
